command: pwd && ls -la && find . -maxdepth 3 -type f | sort | sed -n '1,200p'

nl -ba src/inventory/pricing.py && printf '
--- tests/test_pricing.py ---
' && nl -ba tests/test_pricing.py && printf '
--- tests/conftest.py ---
' && nl -ba tests/conftest.py

printf '%s
' '--- pyproject.toml ---' && cat pyproject.toml && printf '%s
' '--- README.md ---' && cat README.md && printf '%s
' '--- git status ---' && git status --short
cat .gnomon/skills/writing-tests.md 2>/dev/null || true; printf '\n--- policy ---\n'; cat .gnomon/policy.toml 2>/dev/null || true

PYTHONPATH=src python3 - <<'PY'
from inventory.pricing import apply_coupon

assert apply_coupon(100.00, "SAVE10") == 90.00
assert apply_coupon(20.00, "SAVE10") == 18.00
assert apply_coupon(20.00, "FLAT5") == 15.00
assert apply_coupon(3.00, "FLAT5") == 0.00
assert apply_coupon(5.00, "FLAT5") == 0.00
try:
    apply_coupon(10.00, "NOPE")
except ValueError as exc:
    print(f"ValueError raised: {exc}")
else:
    raise AssertionError("unknown code did not raise ValueError")
print("coupon behavior checks passed")
PY
git diff --check && git diff -- src/inventory/pricing.py tests/test_pricing.py && git status --short
